title: Read a JSON body
summary: Gin: Read a JSON body. Send an empty object.
introduction: ShouldBindJSON reads and checks JSON fields. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Read a JSON body with Gin

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Read a JSON body

blocks.text: ShouldBindJSON fills the struct through its pointer and checks required Title. The valid result is returned with 201.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Pass a pointer so the binder can fill the struct.
